name: Smooth
intent: High image quality with materially more GPU, memory and frame-time headroom than the 4K-max profile.

technical_basis.source_reference: Nintendo Switch 1 docked output up to 1920x1080 at 60 Hz
reasoning: 1.25x raises a 1080p-class source to approximately 2400x1350, very close to 2560x1440 output.
The pixel workload is only 39.1% of a 2.0x profile, leaving much more emulation and graphics headroom.
Bilinear is sufficient because only a small final resize is required for a 1080p-class source.
FXAA is retained as a low-cost general anti-aliasing pass when internal resolution is below the 2.0x 4K ceiling.
1440p output is a strong middle ground for modern 4K televisions while reducing presentation bandwidth versus 2160p.
